sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Now I see it! Rows 22-25, cols 44-49 are "pppppp" (purple). So the right square is BLOCKED from moving UP because there's purple above it at rows 22-25, cols 44-49.
So when I pressed UP:
- Left square blocked from UP (magenta at rows 18-21, cols 18-21)
- Right square blocked from UP (purple at rows 22-25, cols 44-49)
- Both blocked → neither moves. This explains why the right square didn't move!
So the mechanic is:
- When both squares can move in the commanded direction, they both move.
- When one square is blocked and the other can move, the one that can move moves in the OPPOSITE direction.
- When both are blocked, neither moves.
Now let me figure out how to move the right square. The right square is at (26, 46), cols 46-49, rows 26-29.
- LEFT: left blocked, right can move LEFT (black at cols 38-45) → right moves RIGHT
- RIGHT: left blocked, right can move RIGHT (black at cols 50-53) → right moves LEFT
- UP: left blocked, right blocked (purple at rows 22-25, cols 44-49) → neither moves
- DOWN: left can move DOWN (black at rows 26-29, cols 18-21), right can move DOWN (black at rows 30-33, cols 46-49) → both move DOWN
So to move the right square LEFT, I press RIGHT. To move it RIGHT, I press LEFT. To move it DOWN, I press DOWN (but this also moves the left square DOWN). To move it UP... I can't directly, since both are blocked from UP.
But wait, if I press DOWN, both squares move DOWN. Then the left square is at row 26, cols 18-21. From there, can the left square move UP? Rows 22-25, cols 18-21 are magenta, so no. Can it move DOWN? Rows 30-33, cols 18-21 are black, so yes.
So after pressing DOWN, the left square is at row 26, cols 18-21. Now:
- UP: left blocked (magenta at rows 22-25), right blocked (purple at rows 22-25) → neither moves
- DOWN: both can move → both move DOWN
- LEFT: left blocked (magenta at cols 14-17), right can move LEFT → right moves RIGHT
- RIGHT: left blocked (magenta at cols 22-25), right can move RIGHT → right moves LEFT
So even after moving the left square DOWN, I still can't move the right square UP because the left square is still blocked from UP.
Hmm, let me think about this differently. Maybe I need to get the left square out of the magenta cutout so it's no longer blocked. But the magenta cutout is surrounded by magenta, so the left square can only move DOWN (to the black region).
Once the left square is in the black region (row 26+), both squares are in the same region. Then they might swap positions like they did in the upper black region.
Let me try pressing DOWN to move both squares into the black region, then see what happens with directional moves.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move both squares DOWN into the black region
result = action(['DOWN'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
squares = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"After DOWN:")
for s in squares:
    print(f"  boundary={s['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
